sentences: DPP16 controls (`quad_perm`, `row_shl/shr/ror/share/xmask/mirror/half_mirror`) and DPP8 (`dpp8` + `fi`) select the source lane, then `row_mask` (one bit per 16-lane row) and `bank_mask` (one bit per 4-lane bank) decide which destination lanes update.
A lane whose row/bank is off is not written.
A source lane outside the row is invalid: `bound_ctrl` 1 uses 0 as src0, otherwise the lane is not written.
A source lane inactive under EXEC is used when `fi` is 1; otherwise `bound_ctrl` decides.
DPP8 always writes an enabled lane: `fi` 1 reads the inactive source, `fi` 0 uses 0.
DPP16/8 never leaves its 16/8-lane group, so this is exact on every subgroup at least that wide; under `--wave64-emulate` the exchange goes through the workgroup buffer like the other cross-lane ops.
GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_dpp*.asm` on an RTX 3070 and hardware-measured on an RX 6800.

On an RX 6700 XT (gfx1031), `tools/crosslane_fuzz.py --dpp-sweep --oracle hw` checks every DPP16 control × `bound_ctrl` × `fi`, every `row_mask`/`bank_mask` pair and the DPP8 selects in wave32 and wave64: 14,412 cases, all matching these rules (BUILD-162, `docs/shader_validation.md` FUZZ-7).
Semantics from the RDNA2 ISA, AMD LLVM modifier syntax and the GPUOpen DPP notes.
